description: Detects Defender real-time/CFA disabling and whole-drive exclusions via Set-MpPreference/Add-MpPreference, plus known AV-removal binaries used by The Gentlemen.
references:
  - https://securelist.com/the-gentlemen-raas/120447/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/25/i/unmasking-the-gentlemen-ransomware.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/29
tags:
  - attack.t1562.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_tools:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\kavrmvr.exe'
      - '\OpenArk64.exe'
      - '\PowerRun.exe'
      - '\Allpatch2.exe'
  selection_ps:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'MpPreference'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'DisableRealtimeMonitoring'
      - 'EnableControlledFolderAccess Disabled'
      - 'ExclusionProcess'
      - 'ExclusionPath'
  condition: selection_tools or selection_ps
level: high
2786.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("kavrmvr.exe","OpenArk64.exe","PowerRun.exe","Allpatch2.exe") OR (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND Processes.process="*MpPreference*" AND (Processes.process="*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*" OR Processes.process="*EnableControlledFolderAccess Disabled*" OR Processes.process="*ExclusionProcess*" OR Processes.process="*ExclusionPath*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2786.datadog: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 ((@Image:*\kavrmvr.exe OR @Image:*\KAVRMVR.EXE OR @Image:*\OpenArk64.exe OR @Image:*\openark64.exe OR @Image:*\PowerRun.exe OR @Image:*\powerrun.exe OR @Image:*\Allpatch2.exe OR @Image:*\allpatch2.exe) OR (@CommandLine:*MpPreference* AND (@CommandLine:*DisableRealtimeMonitoring* OR @CommandLine:*ExclusionProcess* OR @CommandLine:*ExclusionPath*)))
2786.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\(kavrmvr|OpenArk64|PowerRun|Allpatch2)\.exe$/i OR (CommandLine=/MpPreference/i CommandLine=/(DisableRealtimeMonitoring|EnableControlledFolderAccess\s+Disabled|ExclusionProcess|ExclusionPath)/i))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

description: Detects schtasks.exe creating a persistence task named GoogleUpdater (TinyRCT loader) or pointing at a vmtools/VNT-disguised tunneler used by CL-STA-1062.

  - attack.t1036.005
